name: Es-node
source:
Play as a lone wanderer who lost his family in a fire.
Set in modern day Japan during times of great change,
the characters also have no choice but to forge ahead.
Together with your personal heroines, journey into the future.

Presenting the first work from energetic new collaborative Nasska.
"es-node", an adventure game built on the Ren'py novel engine.
Windows, Mac, and Linux compatible
Includes modern discussion and keywords of science, technology, religion, etc.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE064890.html]DLsite.com[/url]]
translation:
扮演一个在火灾中失去家人的孤独流浪者。故事设定在现代日本的巨变时期，角色们也不得不勇往直前。与你的女主角们一起，踏上通往未来的旅程。

活力十足的新团队Nasska的首部作品。“es-node”，一款基于Ren'py小说引擎构建的冒险游戏。兼容Windows、Mac和Linux。包含关于科学、技术、宗教等的现代讨论和关键词。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE064890.html]DLsite.com[/url]]
